from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentExtraction(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of the judgment document, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal nature of the case, e.g., 'Criminal', 'Civil', 'Administrative'")
    specific_charge_or_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific charge (if criminal) or cause of action (if civil/admin) that defines the dispute, e.g., 'Illegal Absorption of Public Deposits', 'Construction Contract Dispute'")
    key_disposition: str | None = Field(description="The court's final disposition or key reasoning regarding the legal nature, e.g., 'Convicted', 'Civil Dispute', 'Compensation Denied'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates extracted records from the processed document(s)."""
    documents: list[DocumentExtraction]
